t: A small sound board that gives a Teensy stereo audio in and out.
steps: Buy the Rev D board from SparkFun for about 10 US dollars. Get a Teensy 4.0 or 4.1 to go with it.
Solder headers onto both boards and stack the audio board on the Teensy.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the free Teensyduino package.
Plug in headphones and connect the Teensy with a USB cable.
Open File, then Examples, then Audio, then Tutorial in the Arduino IDE.
Upload the first tutorial example and listen for sound.
Try the Audio System Design Tool in your browser to draw your own sound setup.
